I love the new re-vamped world menu that you have on the VRChat website!
https://vrchat.com/home/worlds
If any changes are going to be added or modified in the future, I'd like to request the ability to favorite or unfavorite a world when you click on the URL.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Add ability to favorite worlds via website
comments.value:
Either that, or maybe a "world queue", kind of like YouTube's "Watch Later" so I have a list of worlds lined up next time I go into VRChat.
Either way, some way to add worlds to my list on web would be super useful: I always see cool worlds announced by tweet or on Discord, and when I go in VR I forget which ones I wanted to go visit.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
I find it easier to google, browse forums, discords, etc. to find cool worlds (better search or curation tools is a separate request).
I imagine its trivial to implement this. Let me add a handful of worlds to a [favorites] list, so I can hop on later to go exploring with friends
comments.mergedPostTitle: Ability to favorite worlds from web

comments.mergedPostDetails: I want to be able to favorite worlds that i see when i am online on the VRchat website so that i can visit them later rather than saving the link somewhere

Its often that I see a interesting world get posted on Twitter, though not always am I able to dive straight into VRC and explore it.
It would be nice to allow me to favorite a world for later viewing from the VRC website.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Allow the adding of favorite worlds from the website

details:
I would love to be able to manage my favorite worlds playlists through the website. The feature could be a new button titled "Playlists" or something.  This would allow me to search for worlds on the site and create a playlist of worlds to explore in game later. It would also allow me to rearrange worlds I've already favorited.  

I really want to build out that "Escape Hatch" playlist for when we have a busy room and need a quick escape into a lower intensity worlds like my new favorite...Error.mdl's LOADING world.
